content: ⌊ DRAFT g Each SwCluC_LdComProxy_LdCom- CbkRxIndication notification callback, where the parameter LdComUserCall- backType (See [ECUC_LdCom_00025]) is set to LDCOM_RX_INDICATION , shall be configured as SwCluC_LdComProxy_<BS>_LdComCbkRxIndication , where <BS> is the shortName of the SwCluCLdComProxyBaseSocket container.
